# Revenue Partner for Orgo

> Public, reproducible deployment package for The AI Guy Revenue Partner: a
> persistent Hermes Agent for revenue, operations, calendars, inboxes, CRM,
> documents, proposals, Slack, Telegram, and private agent-to-agent work.

Repository: https://github.com/jbellsolutions/revenue-partner-orgo
Human entry point: https://github.com/jbellsolutions/revenue-partner-orgo/blob/main/START-HERE.md
AI setup brief: https://github.com/jbellsolutions/revenue-partner-orgo/blob/main/AGENTS.md

## Instructions for an AI setup agent

1. Read AGENTS.md and START-HERE.md before changing infrastructure.
2. Read orgo/deployment.json as the machine-readable deployment contract.
3. Use the curated system/hermes-agent@1.0.0 template and the repository's
   orgo/setup.sh overlay. Do not publish a Scale-only custom template.
   New names default to Revenue Agent. An optional --name-prefix "Acme" makes
   Acme Revenue Agent; retain the required Revenue Agent suffix. No extra name
   question is needed when the owner supplies no prefix. Connect Slack with the
   personalized ~/.hermes/slack-manifest.json printed by the installer. Respect
   HERMES_HOME when set. Existing profiles retain their names without migration.
4. Keep credentials and customer context on the private Orgo computer, never in
   GitHub or chat output.
5. Connect Slack first, then optional Telegram and business tools.
6. Run orgo/verify.sh and prove a real authorized message before reporting
   completion.

## Deployment contract

Workspace: AI Guy, unless the owner names another customer workspace
Computer: ai-guy-revenue-partner
RAM: 8 GB
CPU: 2 vCPU
Disk: 40 GB
Display: 1440x900x24
Template: system/hermes-agent@1.0.0
Installer: ./orgo/setup.sh
Channel helper: ./orgo/connect-channels.sh
Business-tool helper: ./orgo/connect-tools.sh
A2A helper: ./orgo/connect-a2a.sh
Verifier: ./orgo/verify.sh

## Documentation map

- START-HERE.md: nontechnical standalone installation
- docs/ORGO-SETUP.md: Orgo-specific deployment sequence
- docs/ORGO-REFERENCE.md: source-mapped Orgo API and platform notes
- docs/SLACK-SETUP.md: separate Revenue Partner Slack app
- docs/TOOLS.md: Calendar, inbox, Drive, CRM, PandaDoc, and safe tests
- docs/SKILLS.md: installed and optional Hermes skills
- docs/A2A.md: authenticated private connection to Head of Ops
- SECURITY.md: secrets, approvals, and public/private boundaries

## Safety boundary

An installation is not complete merely because files were copied. It is
complete only after the repository verifier passes and an authorized channel
returns a real response. External sends, calendar edits, proposals, spending,
publishing, deletions, invitations, and customer-record changes require explicit
owner approval.
